ii: the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number
ii chronicles: the second of two Old Testament books telling the history of Judah and Israel until the return from the Babylonian Captivity in 536 BC
ii corinthians: a New Testament book containing the second epistle from Saint Paul to the church at Corinth
ii esdras: an Apocryphal book of angelic revelations
ii john: the second New Testament epistle traditionally attributed to Saint John the Apostle
ii kings: the second of two Old Testament books telling the histories of the kings of Judah and Israel
ii maccabees: an Apocryphal book describing the life of Judas Maccabaeus
ii peter: the second New Testament book traditionally attributed to Saint Peter the Apostle
ii samuel: the second of two books of the Old Testament that tell of Saul and David
ii thessalonians: a New Testament book containing Saint Paul's second epistle to the Thessalonians
ii timothy: a New Testament book containing Saint Paul's second epistle to Timothy
iii: the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one
iii john: the third New Testament epistle traditionally attributed to Saint John the Apostle
iis: the most notorious and possibly the most important arm of Iraq's security system
